description: The Department for Environment and Water publishes a South Australian stormwater drains layer. The provider states that it updated a 2005 dataset with information obtained from local government councils. The mapped drainage assets can provide network geometry for stormwater network flow simulation. Pipe dimensions, hydraulic parameters and connectivity quality have not been checked. A separate City of Charles Sturt inventory already in this catalogue may overlap geographically; the state-level combined inventory has a different publisher and scope. Data.SA lists Shapefile, GeoJSON and compressed KML distributions under CC BY 4.0, with public access. Only catalogue metadata and file headers were inspected. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and observation currency remain unverified. The Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
